_comment: since_year: first publication year shown. cache: the adc-census record cache on this server (overridable with $NAND_CENSUS_CACHE or --cache). venues: regex on the IEEE publication_title that assigns the venue. IMW/NVSMW, IEDM, TED, IRPS, EDL and pre-2022 VLSI Technology are fetched into the cache by adc-census for this site (all but IMW only as NAND/flash keyword hits). IEEE Access is left out because adc-census only fetches its converter papers.

venues.name: IMW
venues.match: international memory workshop|non-?volatile semiconductor memory workshop|\bimw\b|\bnvsmw\b
